title: Canonical degree-zero comparison commutes with open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space, let $V\subseteq U$ be opens, and let $M$ be a module sheaf. For each $x\in H^0(U,M)$ [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], the canonical comparison [lem-sc-open-cohomology-zero-sections] satisfies $c_{V,M}(\operatorname{res}^{H^0}_{U,V}(x))=\operatorname{res}^{\Gamma}_{U,V}(c_{U,M}(x))$.

source.place: Tags 01DZ and 01E1 (2), canonical restriction and degree-zero sections

proof.text: Choose one injective resolution P of M. Form the cochain map induced by section restriction. Cancel the monomorphism iCycles and use naturality of section restriction on the augmentation to identify the maps from M into zeroth cycles.
Use InjectiveResolution.toRightDerivedZero_eq and rightDerived_app_eq on P. Naturality of homologyπ transports the cycles identity to the square for toRightDerivedZero.
Cancel the isomorphism toRightDerivedZero and compose with its inverse to obtain the square for rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf. Evaluate at x.
